name: Walking with the Holy Spirit
promise: Six days on knowing the Holy Spirit, His baptism and fire, and the daily walk of fellowship, intuition and prayer.
why: The Holy Spirit is not a force to use but a Person to know. Jesus called Him the Spirit of truth and handed His course to Him, so the believer's first task is to learn the new Lecturer: who He is, how He gives first-hand knowledge of God, and how He works in the human spirit through fellowship, intuition and conscience. These six sessions then open His baptism and fire, the refinery of tongues that turns His capital into power, and the quick understanding of the Ruach, until walking with Him becomes your daily life.

days.theme: The new Lecturer: the Spirit is Truth itself
days.key_quote: The course doesn't change, but the lecturer changes.

days.theme: First-hand knowledge: knowing Him by experience
days.key_quote: When you experience it, when it comes and you touch it, you make contact with it, you will know it by that experiential knowledge.

days.theme: How He works in you: fellowship, intuition, conscience
days.key_quote: Unction is a knowledge faculty; it's a center for the acquisition of spiritual knowledge.

days.theme: Baptised in the Holy Ghost and fire
days.key_quote: I came to cast the fire in the earth.

days.theme: The refinery: tongues turn capital into power
days.key_quote: The refinery that does the conversion of Holy Ghost power into fine fractions of possibilities, in measures of grace and mercy, is called the ability to speak in tongues.

days.theme: The Ruach: quick understanding from the Breath
days.key_quote: When Ruach comes upon you, it gives you a level of perception that is superior to the perception of your physical senses.
